jobs.description: We are looking for an (Senior) Analyst to join our Transactions Team in Berlin. In this hands-on investment role, you will support acquisitions, disposals, and joint ventures across office, hotel, residential/BTR, logistics, and development assets. Working closely with Senior Transaction Managers and the Co-Head of Transactions, you will be involved in underwriting, financial modelling, due diligence, transaction execution, and investment analysis across Germany and selected international markets. Location: Berlin Your Tasks Transaction Execution & Management Support the full deal lifecycle on acquisitions and disposals across Germany and international markets, covering office, hotel, residential, logistics, and development assets. Prepare financial models, DCF analyses, and business plans for standing assets and development projects; stress-test assumptions and evaluate investment scenarios. Drafting or assisting with drafting and review Letters of Intent (LOIs), term sheets, and other transaction documents. Coordinate and manage due diligence workstreams, including data room management, adviser coordination, and cross-departmental communication. Support signing and closing management, including CP tracking and condition satisfaction. Investment Analysis & Underwriting Screen, evaluate, and underwrite incoming acquisition opportunities across target asset classes and geographies. Prepare investment memoranda, board presentations, and transaction approval documents that clearly communicate financial metrics, investment thesis, and risk/return profile. Develop and maintain financial models (excel-based) for both stabilised assets and value-add / development opportunities; produce Key Metric Summaries. Conduct in-depth feasibility analysis for repositioning, conversion, and development scenarios. Market Research & Deal Origination Conduct comprehensive market research on target real estate sub-markets, including supply/demand dynamics, rental trends, yield movements, and competitive landscape. Build and maintain deal flow tracking tools and acquisition pipeline databases (CRM). (Support) Deal-sourcing efforts through broker engagement, market intelligence, and investment screening. Participate in meetings with brokers, institutional investors, JV partners, and other stakeholders. Your Profile Education & Experience Degree in Business Administration, Real Estate Management, Finance, Economics, or Engineering; MRICS / master's-level qualification a plus. At least two years of professional experience in real estate investment, private equity (real estate), M&A, asset management, valuation, or brokerage. Track record of financial modelling and investment analysis across European real estate markets; experience with development projects is an advantage. Technical Skills Advanced Excel skills, including dynamic financial models, DCF / IRR analysis, and scenario modelling -- proficiency is non-negotiable. Strong PowerPoint skills; ability to produce clear, concise investment presentations and board materials. Hands-on experience with AI tools (e.g. large language models, AI-assisted research, prompt engineering) and/or CRM / deal management platforms is a strong advantage. Familiarity with data room platforms (e.g. Drooms, Intralinks, Datasite) is a plus. Competencies & Personal Profile Strong quantitative and analytical thinking -- able to cut through complexity and build conviction on investment cases. Self-starter with high initiative, ownership mentality, and the ability to manage multiple work streams simultaneously in a fast-paced deal environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills -- ability to present financial analysis and investment logic concisely to senior stakeholders. Meticulous attention to detail, reliability, and a strong sense of accountability. Collaborative team player with a growth mindset and an appetite for continuous learning. Languages: Excellent English (written and spoken) required; fluent German is a strong plus and highly preferred for the German market. Your Perspective Attractive remuneration package Significant scope for professional development and accelerated career progression within a large, institutionally led real estate platform. Deep cross-asset-class exposure: office, hotel, residential/BTR, retail, and development. Interesting, varied and broad range of tasks in one of the largest real estate companies in Germany and Europe Very good IT infrastructure with access to leading AI tools Good atmosphere, communication culture "on a first-name basis" and a pleasant working atmosphere in an environment with flat hierarchies Individual training for professional and personal development in our academy Professionally equipped, in-house gym with trainers and classes Comprehensive company health management and company pension scheme Mobility and flexibility using pool and company cars for the execution of tasks Exciting virtual programs for childcare with our partner company Voiio Discounts at selected hotels worldwide with up to 30% on overnight stays and special conditions on food and beverages Additional days off on Christmas eve & New years eve Have we sparked your interest? jobs.description: WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. If you’re interested in learning how a top management consulting firm creates an impressive candidate experience, this is the team for you.WHAT YOU’LL DO - As Associate, Recruiting (m/f/d), you will support our Intern Hire Team in attracting outstanding talent for consulting internships across our offices in Germany & Austria.- In this role, you will serve as the central point of contact for all candidates throughout the Talent Journey – from the initial contact at a university event through to candidate support during our assessment days.- You will also be responsible for the pre-selection of the most promising candidates for our selection process and will oversee the preparation, execution and follow-up of our assessment days.- You give free rein to your creativity in conceptualizing, planning and executing our campus activities and (flagship) recruiting events, and collaborate with your team colleagues to develop strategies and concepts to further advance our intern hiring.- With your communicative and approachable manner, you also support our internal consultants with all recruiting-related queries.- To make our recruiting success measurable, you regularly prepare analyses along the Talent Journey and present these to your key stakeholders.ABOUT YOU- You have a genuine passion for talent and recruiting.- You leverage your strong communication skills to attract talented individuals to Bain.- You have a strong service orientation and a genuine enthusiasm for daily interaction with candidates and Bainies.- You look forward to taking on responsibility and independently driving topics forward. - You are a resilient and assertive organisational talent who does not shy away from challenges and keeps a cool head under pressure.- You truly thrive in a team setting, built on a foundation of loyalty and reliability.- You are creative, have a sense of humor and impress with a warm and positive presence.YOUR EXPERIENCE- You hold a successfully completed university degree in business administration, social sciences or law, ideally with a focus on human resources management.- You bring initial experience in recruiting and/or campus marketing. - You are proficient in MS Office; initial knowledge of data analytics is an advantage.- Your German and English language skills are excellent, both spoken and writtenWHAT WE OFFER YOUIn addition to an attractive and performance-based remuneration comprising fixed and variable components, you will benefit from numerous additional perks:- Diverse training formats, language courses as well as buddy and mentoring programmes support your personal development- You benefit from the EGYM Wellpass and further offerings for fitness and mental wellbeing- Our mobility concept gives you the flexibility to choose between Mobility Cash, reimbursement of your public transport ticket or JobRad leasing- For us, flexibility means having the best of both worlds: the freedom to work from home and the opportunity to experience genuine team moments in the office – fully in line with our Work@Bain 2.x concept.- With our Community Impact Day and participation in Green Teams, you can make a meaningful difference for society and the environment- Affinity Groups such as Women@Bain promote exchange, networking and career development- Whether Team Retreat, Christmas Party or the „Bain-Wiesn“ – you will experience how fun and team spirit go hand in hand at Bain.- Whether free snacks, beverages or the subsidised catering in our cafeteria (in Munich) – you will find even more at Bain that makes your working day a little bit better.HOW YOU´LL JOIN USHave we sparked your curiosity about an exceptional career with us?
